 Alex Brotherton
 Most recent Most popular GOAL - Arsenal 2-0 Benfica published at 21:26 GMT 21:26 GMT 
 Alessia Russo (66 mins) 
 It's been coming!
 The corner comes in from Steph Catley and Alessia Russo nods home.
 She didn't really have to jump that high there, but it's a beautiful header into the floor and up into the net.
 61 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 65 mins 65 mins 
 Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 Lena Pauels saves a long-range striker from Taylor Hinds, before then having to tip a deflected Olvia Smith effort round the post.
 Arsenal are piling on the pressure.
 10 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 64 mins 64 mins 
 Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 Alessia Russo is going to be having nightmares about Catarina Amado.
 The Arsenal striker runs onto another fine Kyra Cooney-Cross pass, but the Benfica defender makes a superb tackle.
 2 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 63 mins 63 mins 
 Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 Another spell of sustained Arsenal pressure ends with the ball running to Russo seven yards out, but she shoots straight at Lena Pauels in the Benfica goal!
 4 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:21 GMT 21:21 GMT 
 Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 Gilly Flaherty 
Former Arsenal defender on Disney+ 
 You see Smith picking it up, making that run in the wide area and managing to get the ball in. 
 Russo is adamant it should have been a corner and I think she's right.
 9 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 59 mins 59 mins 
 Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 Olivia Smith reaches the byline and crosses, but Alessia Russo can't keep her header down.
 The Arsenal striker is convinced it came off the defender's head last, and the replays show she is right. But a goal-kick is given.
 4 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 58 mins 58 mins 
 Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 A free-kick routine results in Ona Batlle taking a shot from the edge of the box - a few ricochets take the ball into the path of an unmarked Caitlin Foord, but her close-range effort is well saved. The offside flag goes up, so it wouldn't have counted anyway.
 3 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 56 mins 56 mins 
 Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 Ona Batlle beats the defender to get to the byline and stands up a cross to the back post.
 Caitlin Foord meets the cross and heads across the face of goal, but nobody in red can get on the end of it and Benfica clear.
 8 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Smith 'better in a wider area' published at 21:11 GMT 21:11 GMT 
 Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 Gilly Flaherty 
Former Arsenal defender on Disney+ 
 What you've got is Russo playing in the ten, who is getting the ball to feet because she's deeper but you haven't necessarily got Smith coming or going - she's sort of just staying with the centre-backs. 
 Being a former defender, I thought this again in their game against Tottenham, she makes it easy for a defender because if you're standing next to me I'm thinking 'happy days I'm just going to stay with you the whole time' but I think that's what we're really lacking there, what is she offering us? 
 I think Smith for me, is better when she gets the ball and she's able to run at players. That's why I think she's better in a wider area. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 23 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 48 mins 48 mins 
 Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 Caitlin Foord runs onto an inch-perfect ball over the top of the Benfica defence, but just as she looks poised to shoot one-on-one with the goalkeeper, Catarina Amado appears out of nowhere with a superb goal-saving slide tackle.
 4 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 46 mins 46 mins 
 Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 Benfica made a change at the break - Andreia Norton replaced Pauleta, who appeared to pick up a knock in the first half.
 2 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 KICK-OFF published at 21:05 GMT 21:05 GMT 
 Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 Arsenal begin the second half.
 13 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:02 GMT 21:02 GMT 
 HT: Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 It's fair to say that Arsenal had the better of the first half.
 20 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:55 GMT 20:55 GMT 
 HT: Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 Gilly Flaherty 
Former Arsenal defender on Disney+ 
 It's great for Arsenal to get a goal going into the break. Benfica holding on towards the end there with the last-ditch defending but I think for Arsenal they'll be the team that's more pleased coming in at the half-time break but both teams I think can definitely increase it as well. 
 21 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 20:50 GMT 20:50 GMT 
 Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 That's it for the first half.
 Arsenal only have one goal to show for their efforts, but it was a brilliant one from Alessia Russo.
 Benfica were holding on, though could have taken the lead had Froya Dorsin pulled off a lob over Misa Rodriguez.
 30 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 45 mins 45 mins 
 Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 Lena Pauels gets down low to parry a low Alessia Russo strike wide.
 Arsenal are pushing for a two-goal cushion as we approach the break.
 31 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Beautiful strike' published at 20:44 GMT 20:44 GMT 
 Arsenal 1-0 Benfica 
 Gilly Flaherty 
Former Arsenal defender on Disney+ 
 Russo takes one touch, has a little look up and has got one thing on her mind and that's to have the strike before allowing those defenders to come back in and put pressure on her.
 It is a beautiful strike. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 76 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Arsenal 1-0 Benfica published at 20:41 GMT 20:41 GMT 
 Alessia Russo (39 mins) 
 Arsenal finally get their goal!
 Alessia Russo lets a pass from Caitlin Foord on the left run across her body, takes a touch and arrows a low strike into the far corner of the goal off the post.
 That's Russo's seventh goal in her past seven games for club and country.
 She's now level with Fran Kirby as the leading English goal scorer in Women's Champions League history (21 goals).
 Image source, Getty Images 
 224 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:37 GMT 20:37 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page 
 Benfica fans nice and noisy here. Adding to the vibe but still hoping they go home unhappy. Might need the magic of Smilla to break the deadlock...
 Don, Meadow Park 
 15 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Arsenal getting closer' published at 20:35 GMT 20:35 GMT 
 Arsenal 0-0 Benfica 
 Gilly Flaherty 
Former Arsenal defender on Disney+ 
 Much better there from Arsenal and they are getting closer. 
 Good, patient build-up play and that's what I don't think they do enough of - I don't think they play enough forward passes. 
 They are getting closer to getting that goal.
